text: Feel is a kind of a... it's a strong word. Um, I just think it would be a nice gesture on your part.

speaker: kurt
text: She'll get it when she gets it.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Well, there you go. Problem solved.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: A successful quest. Now let's go find a gas station with a clean bathroom.

text: No, the problem isn't solved. He just blew us off.

text: I've got it. He didn't remember me because the last time we met I was in a Halloween costume.

text: Come on, Leonard, let's go

text: No. You can leave if you want to. I'm gonna see this through.

text: Okay.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I guess, technically, that was my fault.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I'm not leaving here without Penny's money.

text: What happened to your backup?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I don't need backup. I have right on my side. And I'm wearing cargo shorts under my pants.

text: Congratulations. You may not have succeeded in getting cash, but you did secure a formal acknowledgment of the debt.

text: Maybe we should have your head notarized.

text: If anybody cares, I still have to pee.

text: Hey.

text: Hey, is Sheldon here?

text: Yeah. Hang on. Sheldon!

text: It's kind of a fashionable look these days.

text: Maybe if you're working on a tuna boat.

text: Hello, Penny.

text: Sheldon, here is your money. Thank you very much. It helped a lot.

text: Darn. I can't seem to get the hang of that.

text: Hey, I know it's none of my business, but where did the money come from?

text: Well, I cut back my expenses like you said and picked up a few more hours at the restaurant, but the biggest thing was, out of the blue, Kurt shows up and gives me the money he owes me.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Really? Did he say why?

speaker: penny
text: Yes, he said he was feeling guilty and wanted to do what was right.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: That's it? Did he give any reason as to why he came to this moral epiphany?

speaker: penny
text: Nope. I just think he's really changed. We're having dinner tomorrow night, and I get to wear my new beret. Bye, guys.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Bye.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well done, Leonard. The true hero doesn't seek adulation, he fights for right and justice simply because it's his nature.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Penny's hooking up with her jerk of an ex-boyfriend and I have indelible ink on my forehead!

text: That's your badge of honour, your warrior's wound, if you will. I was wrong, minstrels will write songs about you.

text: Great.

text: There once was a brave lad named Leonard, with a fi-fi-fiddle-dee-dee. He faced a fearsome giant, while Raj just wanted to pee.
